name: Inerrant Justice — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Inerrant Justice from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Inerrant Justice (Story)" but are not part of the Inerrant Justice entry, which is unchanged.

Quest (Roll a 1d4)
A vigilante down one of your family members for a crime your relative did not commit, and you must bring that vigilante to justice.
You must hunt down the thugs who defiled sacred elven ruins.
Because your home lacks a strong military force keeping order, it falls to you to put an end to a serial criminal who preyed upon your friends or family.
The slave trade has ruined countless lives, and you are determined to seek out the grand slavemaster kingpin and eliminate him.
